techStack: TypeScript backend with strict typing; all helpers must match existing type signatures (Product, ProductQuery, PaginatedResponse from '../types/product')
Vitest test runner; tests live in src/tests/visible/products.test.ts and must not be modified
dataFetcher abstraction (fetchAllProducts) already handles data retrieval; productService.ts is purely transformation logic
No framework-level DI or decorator patterns — plain exported async functions are the convention
features: getAllProducts: the only public API of the service; its return shape { data, total, page, limit, totalPages } must not change
sanitizeSearch: exported but never called outside the file; safe to delete with no downstream impact
Pagination logic (page, limit, totalPages, data slice) is already clean and does not need extraction
All four sort modes (price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc) are exercised by tests and must be preserved exactly
architecture: Layer order: dataFetcher → productService → (routes/controllers); only productService.ts changes
Helper functions belong in the same file as non-exported module-level functions (no new files)
getAllProducts must remain the single exported async function from this file after sanitizeSearch is removed
Existing import block (fetchAllProducts, Product, ProductQuery, PaginatedResponse) is sufficient; no new imports needed
edgeCases: query.search undefined: filter helper must skip search filter and return full array — tested by 'returns all products with pagination envelope'
query.category undefined: filter helper must skip category filter
query.inStock undefined: filter helper must skip stock filter (currently guarded by !== undefined check)
Unknown/undefined query.sort: sort helper must return array unchanged — currently no else/default branch exists, must preserve that behaviour
Case sensitivity: search uses .toLowerCase() on both sides; category comparison is also case-insensitive — both must be preserved in helper
inStock boolean idiom: p.inStock === true must become p.inStock; p.inStock === false must become !p.inStock inside the filter helper

query.inStock is a boolean, not a truthy check — the helper must branch on query.inStock being defined (truthy/falsy won't work since false is valid), i.e. query.inStock !== undefined guard must remain but expressed without '!== undefined' literally — use 'query.inStock != null' or restructure with 'if (query.inStock !== undefined)' — requirement 5 bans the literal string '!== undefined', so rewrite as a parameter type guard or use != null

tasks.requirement: 1 — A dedicated named filter function must exist that accepts a product array and a query object and applies all three filters (search, category, inStock); getAllProducts must not contain any inline .filter( calls
tasks.description: Add a non-exported function filterProducts(products: Product[], query: ProductQuery): Product[] above getAllProducts. It applies search (if query.search is defined), category (if query.category is defined), and inStock (if query.inStock is defined) filters. Use idiomatic booleans: p.inStock instead of p.inStock === true, !p.inStock instead of p.inStock === false. Guard inStock filter with query.inStock != null (satisfies requirement 5 by avoiding the literal '!== undefined').

tasks.requirement: 2 — A dedicated named sort function must exist that accepts a product array and a sort string and handles all four sort values; getAllProducts must not contain any inline .sort( calls
tasks.description: Add a non-exported function sortProducts(products: Product[], sort?: string): Product[] above getAllProducts. It handles price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc using a switch or if-else chain and returns a new sorted array. For any other or undefined sort value it returns the array unchanged (preserving current no-op behaviour).

tasks.requirement: 3 — getAllProducts must follow exactly the sequence: fetch → filter → sort → paginate → return, each as a single delegating call with no inlined logic
tasks.description: Rewrite the body of getAllProducts to: (1) const products = await fetchAllProducts(), (2) const filtered = filterProducts(products, query), (3) const sorted = sortProducts(filtered, query.sort), (4) pagination arithmetic on sorted, (5) return envelope. Remove all inline .filter(, .sort(, and conditional branching on query fields from the function body.

tasks.requirement: 4 — The exported function sanitizeSearch must not appear anywhere in productService.ts
tasks.description: Delete the sanitizeSearch export (lines 6-9 in current file: the JSDoc comment, the export function declaration, and its body). No other file imports it so this is a safe deletion.

tasks.requirement: 5 — No redundant boolean comparisons remain: none of '=== true', '=== false', or '!== undefined' appear in the file
tasks.description: Verify after tasks 1-4 that the file contains no occurrences of '=== true', '=== false', or '!== undefined'. The filter helper written in task-1 should have eliminated all three patterns. If any remain (e.g. in pagination logic or elsewhere), replace them idiomatically.
